venue.name: [Brown University](http://www.brown.edu)

items.information: Competing will cost $3 for entry plus $2 for each event.

items.name: The Hague Open 2009
items.information: Entrance fee is 3.00 euro per person (competitors). The entrance fee includes coffee and tea and some drinks. Entrance fee for guests is 1.00 euro.All fees are paid in cash during on-site registration.

items.name: Utah Cubing Fall Open 2009
items.information: The tournament begins at 9:30 AM. Pre-registration is $5 for the first event, plus $1 for each additional event. On-site registration is $10 for the first event, plus $2 for each additional event. Pizza and drinks will be provided for competitors. Non-competitors will have to pay $2 for food and drink. Pre-registration will be CLOSED Thursday, December 10th.  More information on the website.
